title: What to expect from Proxy and Firewall Support

question.author: member_060
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for proxy and firewall support?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Desktop Client documentation says: The desktop client honors HTTP and SOCKS5 proxies configured in Settings > Network, and it respects the system proxy by default. All traffic goes to CloudBox over port 443; firewalls that allow standard HTTPS need no extra rules. Corporate environments with TLS inspection may cause "Syncing…" to stall — add an exception for the CloudBox endpoints or contact support for the enterprise network guide. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
